intuition: The strictly increasing rule makes the matrix a directed acyclic graph of moves toward larger neighbors.

brute_force.approach: Start a fresh DFS from every cell without caching repeated suffix paths.
brute_force.time: Exponential in the number of cells
brute_force.space: O(mn) recursion in the worst case

optimal.approach: Memoize the longest increasing path starting at each cell and recurse only to larger four-directional neighbors.

edge_cases: A single-cell matrix has path length one.
A constant-valued matrix has no increasing move.
